test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Embezzlement
solution:
The correct answer is: **Misappropriation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Embezzlement"** means the act of stealing or misappropriating money or property entrusted to one's care, often in the context of employment. (गबन)

 
 
• **Example: **The accountant was fired for **embezzlement **after it was discovered he had been stealing company funds for years.
 
 
 
• **"Misappropriation"** refers to the wrongful or dishonest use of funds or property for one's own use. (दुरुपयोग)
 
 
• **Example: **The charity's director was accused of **misappropriation **of donations.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Embezzlement'** is **'Misappropriation'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Management **(प्रबंधन): The process of dealing with or controlling things or people.

 
 
• **Example:** Good **management **is crucial for the success of any business.
 
 
 
• **Disposition **(स्वभाव): A person's inherent qualities of mind and character.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a cheerful **disposition **that makes her very popular.
 
 
 
• **Confusion** (गड़बड़ी): Lack of understanding; uncertainty.
 
 
• **Example:** There was some **confusion **about the meeting time.
